scenes.text: Meet Pandu Wicaksono — a full-stack developer for e-commerce and business systems.
As the sole developer, he built a production ordering platform: a customer storefront, a B2B partner portal, an admin console and a REST API.
The stack: React, TypeScript, NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL — with secure payments, a pricing engine and real-time order tracking.
His portfolio brings it together in one link, with three live demos: a React storefront, an Angular dashboard and a Vue invoice tool.
Every app is bilingual, WCAG-accessible, secured by a strict Content Security Policy and tested end to end.
Pandu is certified by Google, IBM, Microsoft and Amazon, and open to full-stack and front-end roles.
Let's connect — the portfolio link is in the comments.
